gen-gf-iansui-manrope: A hand-drawn feel runs through Iansui, with gently flared curve ends that never quite touch. Manrope follows with a bright gap at every curve's mouth and a pen line that holds one width from start to finish, so a long stretch of text moves smoothly.
gen-gf-iansui-montserrat: Iansui looks handwritten, its diagonals as thick as its uprights and its curve ends gently flared. Montserrat is the opposite talent: oversized e and a counters and a glide like wire, where Iansui brings the personal touch.
gen-gf-iansui-satoshi: Friendly handwriting meets a tall, upright partner, with Iansui's flared curve ends set over Satoshi's soaring x-height. The difference in lowercase height is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-iansui-switzer: Switzer reads tubular and wire-like, with a tall waist line and tips that never creep toward touching. Beside Iansui's hand-drawn warmth, the strongest quality is the shift from loose handwriting to Swiss precision.
gen-gf-iansui-work-sans: Friendly is the first word for Iansui, with diagonals as thick as its uprights and a hand-drawn wobble. Work Sans sets its mean line high and keeps its joins sturdy, and that gap in lowercase height is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-epunda-slab: Iceberg draws wirelike strokes of one thickness, as if with a marker tip, and its lowercase eyes are large. And Epunda Slab, a serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms, would carry paragraphs with a dignified, unhurried feel.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-fauna-one: Expressive is the right word for Iceberg, its marker-tip letters showing no contrast between stems and joins. And Fauna One, a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, settles in underneath as the literary, quieter voice.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-glegoo: Bold marker-tip letters give Iceberg its expressive look, with no thick-thin modulation anywhere. Glegoo answers with big counters in a tall lowercase and wide, unclosed curves, and that difference in temperament is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-graduate: Marker-tip letters, loud and blunt: that is Iceberg. Graduate, a serif with generous white between letters and almost no step from capital to lowercase height, would read as dignified and bookish over a long page.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-hanuman: Blunt, marker-drawn Iceberg has no swelling where curves meet stems and big, open lowercase eyes. And Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, adds a traditional, refined counterweight beneath it.
